questions.q: The text is about ______ in our community.
questions.passage: Each worker does their best to help our community. Water resources engineers make sure we get clean water in our homes, schools, and other places. Paramedics do an important job. They work hard to help people in emergencies and save lives. Traffic officers help people cross the road and control cars. Without them, traffic would be noisy and dangerous. Street cleaners clean the streets and help keep the city beautiful. Mechanics fix cars and buses to help us move from one place to another. I think all jobs are important.
